ChangedPublicContracts.Compatibility: Additive owner query. No existing workspace mod consumes it; invalid IDs return -1.
Renamed from WallBulldoze with unchanged numeric value; no workspace reference to the old name.
Renamed from Unknown with unchanged numeric value. CastlePlanner uses default only for an unsuccessful out parameter, retaining compatibility with 2.10.4.
The former 32-bit unknown word at 0x538 is split into two 16-bit fields without moving later fields; no workspace consumer reads either.
Four 32-bit words are represented as pairs of 16-bit fields at the same offsets. The named target ID is now UInt16 at 0x340; no workspace consumer uses these changed fields.

Changes: Kept AIV decoration fallback compatible with Script Extender 2.11.0 and earlier supported versions.

CompatibilityNotes: The installed 2.11.0 SHCDESE.dll, local bin output and mod_output are byte-identical; no extender rebuild is required.

The new speech-path inline hook at RVA 0xFEF21 does not overlap local or Fixes patches. A local 2.11.0 game log recorded a 134-byte NotSendingGoods audio reference and the user reports successful playback; the existing earlier 100-byte message-record copy remains a pre-existing field-overwrite risk and is reported separately.
The older projectile slot-view adapter remains applicable and compatible with the corrected live-slot view.
The known early native crash-handler false alarm has no source-level fix in this release; retain its version-neutral documentation until runtime evidence proves otherwise.

The rcnet change is a reverse-engineering project artifact. The new module-bound CrusaderDE AOB is unique, but its extracted symbol is unknown, so it creates no new Ghidra label; a current-only Ghidra import is nevertheless run explicitly for this release audit.
